component.name: ShokujoDX
component.summary: Make embroidery designs and machine files

description.p: Draw shapes, lettering and appliqué, or start from a picture or SVG artwork. The program makes the stitches and writes the files of embroidery machines (DST, PES, VP3, JEF, EXP and more).
Lettering with bundled embroidery fonts, Picture to design, specialty stitches, thread charts, worksheets, shop tools and a parametric sketch mode are included.
